mentions.name: AI-driven agent platform
mentions.description: An AI-driven agent platform built as a personal project, using LangGraph for workflow orchestration and MCP to coordinate multiple agents and models. It integrates LLMs, vector databases, and external APIs into a scalable backend system.
mentions.source_excerpt: Right now, I’m focused on a personal project where I’m building an AI-driven agent platform. I’ve been working with LangGraph for workflow orchestration and MCP for coordinating multiple agents and models. Through this, I’ve gained practical experience integrating LLMs, vector databases, and external APIs into a scalable backend system.
